title: Glioma IDH Classification via CVAE: Synthetic Augmentation, Generative Classification, and MIL for Raman Biopsies
abstract: arXiv:2607.10196v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Biomedical Raman datasets used in machine learning for glioma diagnostics are characterized by small cohort size and absence of diagnostic tissue annotations. We address both problems using a $\beta$-regularized conditional variational autoencoder and a dataset of 59 glioma biopsies from 46 patients for binary IDH-status classification. The $\beta$-CVAE was used as a: (1) Raman spectra generator; (2) generative classifier of Raman spectra; (3) Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) classifier of biopsy slides. Four classifiers were trained on real spectra, synthetic spectra, or a combined set and evaluated on held-out real slides. Random Forest and XGBoost achieved accuracy $0.83$ with synthetic training and $0.81$ with real training. Augmentation increased RF+SVM accuracy from $0.76$ to $0.83$; changes for the other classifiers were smaller. translated_title: 基于CVAE的胶质瘤IDH分类：拉曼活检的合成数据增强、生成式分类与多实例学习
translated_abstract: 用于胶质瘤诊断机器学习的生物医学拉曼数据集的特点是队列规模小且缺乏诊断组织标注。我们使用β正则化条件变分自编码器（β-CVAE）以及一个包含来自46名患者的59个胶质瘤活检样本的数据集来解决这两个问题，用于IDH状态的二分类。β-CVAE被用作：(1) 拉曼光谱生成器；(2) 拉曼光谱的生成式分类器；(3) 活检切片的多实例学习（MIL）分类器。四个分类器分别在真实光谱、合成光谱或两者组合的数据集上训练，并在留出的真实切片上进行评估。随机森林和XGBoost在合成数据训练下达到0.83的准确率，在真实数据训练下达到0.81。数据增强使RF+SVM的准确率从0.76提升至0.83；其他分类器的变化较小。我们证明了β-CVAE模型可以成功用于训练IDH状态分类器。
tldr: 该研究利用β-CVAE同时解决拉曼活检数据集样本量小和缺乏组织标注两大难题，通过合成数据增强、生成式分类和多实例学习，将胶质瘤IDH状态二分类准确率提升至0.83。
en_tdlr: This study uses a β-CVAE to simultaneously address small cohort size and lack of tissue annotations in Raman biopsy datasets, improving glioma IDH-status binary classification accuracy to 0.83 through synthetic augmentation, generative classification, and multiple instance learning.
